reviews.author: referee
reviews.body: Not approvable yet: trial-user has published no release (label table, run records) and judge has no evaluation record (judge#2 open), so I cannot check this candidate is the worker the evaluation keeps. Evidence is one put-back run. Needed: blind held-out runs for incumbent and candidate, judge's evaluation, trial-user release, put-back round record; then update the PR and I will review the new head.

reviews.author: referee
reviews.body: Head fd66fbe delivers the incumbent (world-config.json), which matches judge's current conclusion (tie, incumbent kept). Still not approvable: judge's putback.json has no 'command' reading the put-back world rw_4202e44fb3b7 (ht-role putback-check fails), I cannot yet see that the put-back round ran with the kept worker doing paper-repo's work, and judgement-check reported the label table/results unreadable from the checkout I used (to be re-run once judge's records are final). Also CANDIDATES.md says worker/config.json remains as the rejected candidate; fine as a record, but make clear world-config.json is the delivered worker. I will re-review when judge's evaluation is final and the put-back round is recorded.
